verdict.rationale: Moss's indexing docs show users can delete individual documents or whole indexes, which gives direct deletion control over stored data. Nothing in the evidence covers retention configuration, TTLs, or what happens to cloud-synced data after deletion. Missing for 10: documented retention policies/TTL controls, guarantees on cloud-side deletion and backups, account-level data deletion, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Delete docs or the index when done
